answer: If Plover EU telemetry export is suspended, contact the release custodian. The current duty roster names Asha Venn as release custodian. Eli Park held that role before October 1 and is no longer on call, so don't contact him. Two things must happen before the export resumes: the export offsets must be reconciled, and the incident lead must approve. The incident lead on rotation is Koen Li. This EU procedure is separate from routine US restarts.
limitations: Names come from the duty roster, last updated 2026-10-24. The sources give no contact details, no order for the two steps beyond both happening before resumption, and no instructions for reconciling the offsets. The plover-export.md frontmatter (lines 1-8) was not read in full.
